//: Colours are lifted from src/index.css (the shipped petrol accent, light theme) so the marketing set cannot drift from the app.
//backgrounds: Presets referenced by slide.background. `panoramic` stretches one gradient across the whole set and offsets it per slide, so the deck reads as a strip when swiped.
//ribbon: The corner ribbon ("Kostenlos"), switched on per target in screenshots.config.json. bg is the app's own delete red (--t-swipe-delete in src/index.css); white on it is 4.4:1, and the ribbon's type is large and bold.
//device: The frame is drawn in CSS, not composited from a PNG. See assets/frames/README.md. bezel/radius are in template px at 1x; the screen box is derived from the raw capture's own aspect ratio so the app pixels are never stretched.
